name: Aceternity UI
summary: Free animated React/Next components (Tailwind + Motion) via shadcn @aceternity registry; Pro blocks/templates excluded.
gaps: No SPDX license string found on primary free-component sources; free-use terms in llms-full.txt + /licence (Pro-titled page). Field omitted rather than inventing MIT.
api/components meta.github https://github.com/aceternity/ui returned 404 during research — repoUrl omitted.
Pilot includes 12 free registry UI components of ~112 free components (ai-recommendations / api); not a full inventory.
Pro blocks (/blocks/*), pages, and templates excluded (proOnly / not unlocked).

Some popular free items use mismatched docs vs registry slugs (e.g. registry `lamp` → docs `/components/lamp-effect`, `3d-card` → `/3d-card-effect`, `glowing-stars` → `/glowing-stars-effect`) — excluded from this pilot set to keep slug==docs URL.
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for Aceternity (heavy Motion previews); demos are docs iframes, not dynamic-import smoke mounts.

components.name: Background Beams
components.summary: Animated SVG path beams for hero section backgrounds.
components.copyCode: npx shadcn@latest add @aceternity/background-beams import { BackgroundBeams } from "@/components/ui/background-beams"

copyPrompt.text: Use Aceternity UI free component `Background Beams` (slug `background-beams`) from https://ui.aceternity.com/components/background-beams. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @aceternity/background-beams` after `npx shadcn@latest init` in a React/Next + Tailwind project (Aceternity is registered as the `@aceternity` shadcn namespace; registry item https://ui.aceternity.com/registry/background-beams.json). Import `{ BackgroundBeams }` from `@/components/ui/background-beams` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + Tailwind; registry lists dependency `motion`. This entry is free-tier only — do not install Aceternity Pro blocks (`/blocks/*`), templates, or All-Access content unless the user has Pro. Prefer free components from https://ui.aceternity.com/components. License: free-use terms for personal/commercial projects; do not resell/redistribute as a competing library (see https://ui.aceternity.com/licence and https://ui.aceternity.com/llms-full.txt). No SPDX MIT claimed in catalog.
